Footer

Configure footer text that appears at the bottom of inter account transfers.

Use footers to add terms, conditions, or additional information to inter account transfers.

Name

Enter a name to identify this footer template.

Content

Enter the footer text that will appear at the bottom of inter account transfers. You can use formatting and multiple lines.

Inactive

Check this box to deactivate this footer. It won't appear in selection lists but existing transfers will retain it.
